about.body:
**The Starboy Spell** is seven days from Bangkok's art, street food and late-night energy to Phuket's beaches, Phi Phi island hopping and Old Town discoveries.

**11-17 October 2026 · Bangkok & Phuket, Thailand**

Start with a luxury Art Gallery tour, a drag show and underground clubs. Wander Iconsiam, Song What Road and Chinatown before a rooftop night. Thai cooking class if you're feeling extra cultural (optional)  **The Weeknd concert tickets are included**. Then reset with a spa day and fly to Phuket for beachside evenings, **included Phi Phi island hopping**, ATV riding if you need extra adventure and one last Old Town wander.

**Priced 85,000, includes the tickets, the internal flights, activities and all transfers**
about.quote: Turn up the night. Slow down by the water.

itinerary.body:
We’re kicking things off the Bangkok way!

First stop: **the dispensary** 🌿 followed by a little dose of local culture at an **art museum**. And if art is not your thing and you'd wanna get cheeky, then start your evening evening with a **Drag Show** 💋✨ 

Once the sun goes down, it’s time to get dressed, grab your crew and dive into Bangkok’s underground nightlife. We’re heading to **Bacarrat or Apt 101** for drinks, music and a proper first night out.

**Culture by day. Chaos by night.** Sounds like a good start to us. ;)
itinerary.title: Arrival ,Art/ Drag Show, Party Underground
itinerary.subtitle: Sunday, 11 October 2026

highlights.text: Ice break the logout way 🌿 f

itinerary.body:
Today is for doing what we do best: **shopping, eating and pretending we’re not tired.**

We’re starting with some serious retail therapy at **ICONSIAM**  because obviously one cannot come to Bangkok and not shop. 🛍️

Then it’s back to the villa for a little reset before we head out again.

Next up: **Song Wat Road** for that cool, artsy Bangkok energy, followed by a proper **Chinatown food crawl**. Come hungry. Leave happy. 🍜🥢

And because we refuse to end the night quietly, we’re taking it to the sky at **Akara Sky Hanuman** for rooftop drinks, city views and a little more dancing. 🌃🥂

Basically: shop till you drop, eat till you can’t, then party non stop!!
itinerary.title: BKK Shopping , Food Crawl and Night Out
itinerary.subtitle: Monday, 12 October 2026

itinerary.body:
*Okay. This is the one.*

Sleep in, slow morning, good food and absolutely no pressure to do anything too ambitious because TONIGHT IS CONCERT NIGHT.

For anyone who wants to get a little more hands on with Thai culture, we have an **optional Thai cooking experience** 🍜🌶️

Then it’s time to get ready.

**Outfits? Planned.
Camera roll? Empty.
Energy? Questionable.
Excitement? VERY REAL.**

**Because tonight we’re going to see THE WEEKND LIVE. 🖤🌙**

Concert night. Bangkok. The Weeknd. You know the drill.

Get ready to scream every lyric.

image.name: The Weeknd performing under red stage lights. Background extended with AI; not the Bangkok event or an endorsement.

itinerary.title: WEEDKEND DAY
itinerary.subtitle: Tuesday, 13 October 2026

itinerary.body:
After last night’s concert chaos, we’re taking things slow today.

Time for a proper **Thai massage + spa day** because our bodies have officially filed a complaint. 💆‍♀️✨

Once we’re feeling brand new, we’re packing up and **flying to Phuket!**

And obviously, we’re not wasting a second once we get there.

We’re heading straight for a beachside dinner + drinks 🌊🍸 with sunset skies, salty hair and that “okay, this is exactly where we’re supposed to be” feeling.

Bangkok was a vibe. Phuket is about to be a whole mood.
itinerary.title: Spa day, Bbye BKK, Hello BEACHES 🌴🧖‍♀️🍹
itinerary.subtitle: Wednesday, 14 October 2026

itinerary.body:
Today we’re trading city streets for turquoise water and tiny islands.

We’re off on our **Phi Phi Island Hopping Tour** 🛥️🌊

Think crystal clear water, beach stops, boat rides, swimming, sunshine and approximately 8000 photos that will all look like a travel campaign.

This is your main character on a boat day.

Sunscreen? YES.
Swimwear? YES.
Camera? OBVIOUSLY.
Leaving the water? Unfortunately, eventually.

Island hopping, but make it iconic.
itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island
itinerary.subtitle: Thursday, 15 October 2026

itinerary.body:
We’re calling this one Adventure Day.

For the adrenaline buddies, there’s an **optional ATV ride 🏎️💨** because apparently relaxing on a beach for an entire day is too easy.

Then we slow things down and head to **Café del Mar for lunch, drinks and that dreamy Phuket sunset moment. 🌅🍹**

And just when you thought we were done...

PATONG STREET.

Nightlife, music, dancing and absolutely no promises about what time we’re getting home. 🪩

Go fast. Watch the sunset. Dance till late.
itinerary.title: Adventure + Chaos 🏎️🌅🪩
itinerary.subtitle: Friday, 16 October 2026

itinerary.body:
Our last day calls for a little slow living.

We’re wandering through **Phuket Old Town Market**, grabbing cute little things we definitely didn’t plan on buying, discovering local Thai brands and hunting down the perfect souvenirs. 🛍️🎀

Then it’s time for café hopping, one last iced Thai tea, one last wander and approximately 47 final photos because nobody is emotionally ready to leave yet. ☕️📸

We’ll squeeze in a little more shopping, pick up those “I got this in Thailand” pieces and then...

**Head to the airport. ✈️**

Seven days. Two cities. Islands, concerts, rooftops, street food, beach days and probably way too many photos.

Until the next adventure. 🤍

itinerary.title: SLOW GOODBYES 🥐
itinerary.subtitle: Saturday, 17 October 2026
